name: Making Repairs
summary: At the fortress, a shortage of building materials has made restoration difficult. You are sent to Shadowvale to search for lumber.

sections.title: Supplies at Shadowvale
sections.body: Shadowvale is a ruined village in the Whispering Forest, southwest of the fortress. Search an old root cellar in one of its buildings for usable materials. The fortress lies far from settled lands, so bringing in supplies is difficult. Its repairs depend on what can be found there.

faq.answer: The fortress needs building materials to help restore it. Its distance from the Undercity makes supplies difficult to bring in.
Shadowvale lies in ruins in the Whispering Forest, southwest of the fortress.

faq.q: Where might usable materials be found?
faq.answer: Usable materials may be stored in an old root cellar in one of Shadowvale's buildings.

faq.q: What is the fortress short of?
faq.answer: The fortress is short of building materials needed for its restoration.
